title: ChatMessageCreated
description: A message was written in a haul's chat between the driver and the shipper. Realtime shows it at once; notify pushes it to whoever is not looking.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

client_message_id.description: The sending app's id for the message, so a resend after a lost reply shows once.

sender_side.title: ChatSide
sender_side.description: The side of the haul the person writes for.

recipient_user_ids.description: People on the other side who should hear it: today the driver or the person who posted the load.

text.description: The words; for a quick reply, its text in the sender's language. Null for a bare photo or location.

quick_reply_code.description: Code from the quick replies catalogue when `kind` is `quick_reply`.

photo_file_id.description: The `chat_photo` file; the app reads its link over REST.
